Wendy’s Rejects $1.4 Billion Buyout Offer from Nelson Peltz’s Trian

The rebuffed offer came as Wendy’s reported lower third-quarter profit and revenue

By

Wendy’s board rejected an offer from Nelson Peltz’s hedge fund Trian Fund Management to buy the fast-food chain for around $1.4 billion.

The company said Thursday that a committee formed by its board to review the proposal found the offer substantially undervalues it and doesn’t reflect the growth potential of its turnaround plan.
